_doc: members: per-clip network forward only, 10 s @ 16 kHz. flops = torch.utils.flop_counter total on CPU at batch 1 (counter convention: 2 per MAC), flops_b4_per_clip = batch 4 / 4 (check). params = all parameters of the net as loaded (lean nets have no dead modules). lat_*_ms = median ms of 50 timed runs after 10 warm-up, GPU 0, fp32, eval, no_grad, synchronize; *_iqr = 75th-25th percentile; b32 values are per clip (batch time / 32). fc_* b1 uses TFgram train=False (eval.py), b32 train=True (extract.py); beats timed on a precomputed fbank. frontends are EXCLUDED from the primary cost: Log-Mel CPU ms/clip (torchaudio Wave2Mel), BEATs Kaldi fbank CPU ms/clip and GPU ms/clip at b32. clips: test wav counts per machine type for dev and eval. x1f = 8 fc_nogain + 4 fc_spec + 3 BEATs: flops_total and lat_b32_ms_per_clip_total sum over members; beats_share_* = BEATs part of that total. Latency is never compared across GPUs.

fc_nogain.note: b1 uses TFgram train=False (as eval.py); b32 uses train=True (as extract.py)

fc_spec.note: b1 uses TFgram train=False (as eval.py); b32 uses train=True (as extract.py)
